description.value:
You seize a Large or smaller creature or object that isn't worn or carried and hurl it through the air. The target makes a Strength saving throw (an object automatically fails). On a failure it flies a distance set by its size — 90 feet for Tiny, 60 for Small, 30 for Medium, or 10 for Large — in a direction you choose. If it strikes something else at the end of that movement, both it and what it struck take 2d8 force damage.

Cast with a 3rd-level slot or higher, the maximum throwing distance increases by 10 feet (to a cap of 90 feet) and the damage increases by 1d8.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, Level 2
